caseNameFull: COHON v. KIRBY, DIRECTOR, DEPARTMENT OF ALCOHOLIC BEVERAGE CONTROL OF CALIFORNIA
attorneys: Herbert A. Leland, Marc E. Leland, J. Bruce Fratis, Joseph L. Alioto, and Richard Saveri for appellants., Thomas C. Lynch, Attorney General of California, and Elizabeth Palmer and L. Stephen Porter, Deputy Attorneys General, for appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
